name: The atelier wall
summary: A day nursery hung like an exhibition. The first screen is the children's work, full width, one piece at a time, with a gallery caption card that says what it is, which room made it and the area of learning; the nursery's name and menu sit under the work like a museum label. Rooms read as a list of works, fees and the week's cost sit on caption cards. Gallery-stone ground, ink words, one colour from a rosehip. Gentium Book Plus alone, roman and italic. Children never identifiable: rooms, materials and the work carry it. For day nurseries and pre-schools.
